effect.u_message: Judeau fought to keep a path open for the others. Only his knives and a small hilt remain in the blood-soaked earth.
Pippin stood his ground when the line collapsed. The clasp from his armor is still caught beneath his hand.
Corkus ran toward a gap in the swarm. The path closed before he reached it.
Gaston faced the center of the ceremony. Whatever he saw there stopped him in his tracks.
Someone abandoned a satchel of bandages and painkillers. A hunter circles nearby; taking them may cost more than a detour.
These tracks split around the pits. One route winds wide and quiet; the shorter route leads past the hunter.
The creatures are occupied with the dead. You can cross the open flank or challenge the cluster head-on.
The field grows still. Ahead lies Griffith and the end of the procession. Your way back vanished when the Behelit opened.
